collection.description: A nursing mother is teaching a craft when her baby needs feeding, and an apprentice assumes the lesson must end.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (mother), a nursing mother, is teaching a craft when her baby needs feeding, and (apprentice), an apprentice, assumes the lesson must end.

choices.label: Ask the Teacher What She Prefers

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: She chooses a break and resumes when ready.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A mistake gives (mother) a useful example to discuss afterward.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The lesson continues smoothly without replacing her authority.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The substitute teaches differently, and the class compares both approaches.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The group returns at a time that works better for her.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (mother) asks that future lessons include flexible breaks for everyone.

a1__fx.text: She continues explaining while feeding, and (apprentice) learns the technique.
